name: Golay digital error-correcting codes
description: Binary and ternary codes described for correcting transmission errors in blocks of symbols.

events.statement: NASA reports Golay encoding was used in the Voyager Jupiter encounter telemetry system.

evidence.supports: NASA describes Golay encoding at Jupiter and Saturn and dates the Jupiter encounter to 1979.
The 1979 catalog entry describes the completed Voyager 1 Jupiter encounter and its communications.

events.caveats: This mission-specific application does not imply all data used Golay.
